prompt: What is the difference between keyPressed() and keyTyped()?
choices: keyTyped fires for any key; keyPressed only fires for printable characters
keyPressed fires for any key event; keyTyped fires only when a printable character is generated
They fire in the same situations — just different naming conventions
keyTyped fires when the key is released
explanation: keyTyped fires when a Unicode character is produced (printable keys like A-Z, 0-9). keyPressed fires for every physical key press, including Shift, Ctrl, Delete, arrow keys. Use keyPressed for game controls and function keys; keyTyped for text input.
